security_spec.violation_condition: In QEMU, when riscv_iommu_ctx_fetch() implicitly assigns a default process_id via DPE (line 1167: ctx->process_id = 0, replacing NOPROCID), subsequent fault reports at line 699 and line 1658 use !!ctx->process_id or enable_pid (derived from DC_TC_PDTV) to set the PV bit in the fault queue record, instead of preserving the original pid_valid from the transaction request. This diverges from the spec requirement that fault reports must use orig_pid_valid — the pid_valid value as it was when the translation request entered the IOMMU, before any implicit PID assignment.
security_spec.summary: Fault report PV bit reflects post-modification ctx->process_id instead of original transaction pid_valid, causing guest system software to misidentify whether the faulting request carried a process ID
